records.source: Even if a movie is bad, it's interesting to analyze.
records.translation: 就算電影很糟，分析起來仍然很有意思。

records.source: Hmm... I wonder what aspect of human motivation is satisfied by the narrative of this film?$3
records.translation: 嗯……不知道這部電影的敘事滿足了人類動機的哪一個面向？$3

records.source: I feel out of place here... I hope I'm not bothering anyone.$s
records.translation: 我覺得自己和這裡格格不入……希望沒有打擾任何人。$s

records.source: Linus is looking at the floor...
records.translation: 萊納斯低頭看著地板……

records.source: Why stare at a screen when you could experience these things yourself?$s
records.translation: 既然能親自體驗這些事，為什麼還要盯著銀幕看？$s

records.source: I feel out of place here... I hope I'm not bothering anyone.$s
records.translation: 我覺得自己和這裡格格不入……希望沒有打擾任何人。$s

records.source: Linus is looking at the floor...
records.translation: 萊納斯低頭看著地板……

records.source: I'm not used to that much stimulation... sorry if I was a disappointing guest, @. I still appreciate your inviting me!
records.translation: 我不習慣受到這麼多刺激……@，如果我的表現讓你失望，很抱歉。不過還是非常感謝你的邀請！

records.source: Oh, wow! A palace constructed for the sole purpose of entertainment!
records.translation: 喔，哇！一座完全為了娛樂而建造的宮殿！

records.source: Dwarf seems to be in a deep trance...
records.translation: 矮人似乎陷入深度恍惚……

records.source: I didn't understand a thing, but the flashing lights were mesmerizing!
records.translation: 我什麼也看不懂，不過那些閃爍的燈光令人著迷！

records.source: I know I'm going to love this movie! It was really nice of you to invite me, @.$h
records.translation: 我知道自己一定會喜歡這部電影！@，你願意邀請我，真的很貼心。$h

records.source: Oh, I'm so glad the family was alright in the end. And the cows, too!$h
records.translation: 喔，真高興那一家人最後平安無事。乳牛也是！$h

records.source: I'm pretty easy-going when it comes to movies... I like just about everything!
records.translation: 看電影方面我很隨和……幾乎什麼都喜歡！

records.source: I had a great time, @! Thanks for thinking of me.
records.translation: 我看得非常開心，@！謝謝你想到我。

records.source: Buh... Yeah, I guess this might be okay. *sniff* *sniff* ... a snack might help.
records.translation: 呃……好吧，我想這部片也許還行。*嗅嗅* *嗅嗅*……來份點心可能會更好。

records.source: I'm rooting for the villain... *urp*
records.translation: 我支持反派……*打嗝*

records.source: Okay, I'll admit... I thought it was pretty good.
records.translation: 好吧，我承認……我覺得還挺不錯。

records.source: Heh. I'm actually interested in seeing this one...
records.translation: 嘿。其實我對這部片挺有興趣……

records.source: Okay, this is good...$h
records.translation: 好吧，這部真的不錯……$h

records.source: Shane's trying not to smile.
records.translation: 謝恩正努力忍住笑意。

records.source: When you're watching a good movie, you can forget about everything else... That's a gift.
records.translation: 看一部好電影時，可以忘掉其他一切……那是一份恩賜。

records.source: Buh... Yeah, I guess this might be okay. *sniff* *sniff* ... a snack might help.
records.translation: 呃……好吧，我想這部片也許還行。*嗅嗅* *嗅嗅*……來份點心可能會更好。

records.source: Okay, I'll admit... I thought it was pretty good.
records.translation: 好吧，我承認……我覺得還挺不錯。

records.source: Ugh... this is going to be painful.
records.translation: 呃……這會很難熬。

records.source: Shane's slumped over...
records.translation: 謝恩癱在座位上……

records.source: I feel depressed...$s
records.translation: 我覺得好沮喪……$s

records.source: I'm really happy to see a movie!
records.translation: 能來看電影，我真的好開心！

records.source: Jas is ecstatic!
records.translation: 賈斯欣喜若狂！

records.source: That was so much fun! Thanks for bringing me!$h
records.translation: 真的太好玩了！謝謝你帶我來！$h

records.source: This is a grown-up movie, right? I'll be okay!
records.translation: 這是給大人看的電影，對吧？我沒問題！

records.source: Jas is nodding and glancing sideways.
records.translation: 賈斯一邊點頭，一邊朝旁邊偷看。

records.source: I thought it was good! It had... um... good 'die-a-log'! ...right?
records.translation: 我覺得很好看！裡面有……呃……很棒的「對、對話」！……對吧？

records.source: I... I'm not sure I'm allowed to see this...$s
records.translation: 我……我不確定自己能不能看這部……$s

records.source: I'm scared...$s
records.translation: 我好害怕……$s

records.source: Jas is trembling.
records.translation: 賈斯渾身顫抖。

records.source: *sniff*...$s
records.translation: *吸鼻子*……$s

records.source: I've heard there's some really beautiful nature footage in this one... I'm really looking forward to it!$h
records.translation: 聽說這部片有一些非常美麗的大自然影像……我真的很期待！$h

records.source: That was great. I'm pretty sure I even saw my cabin in one of those Stardew Valley aerial shots!$h
records.translation: 真的很棒。我很確定自己甚至在其中一個星露谷航拍鏡頭裡看到了小屋！$h

records.source: I'm really intrigued by this movie... I'm a sucker for the mysterious.
records.translation: 這部電影讓我非常好奇……我完全無法抗拒神祕的事物。

records.source: That was great! The narrative was very loose, but I think it was intended to speak to the emotions, not the intellect.
records.translation: 真的很棒！敘事非常鬆散，不過我想它原本就是要與情感對話，而不是訴諸理智。

records.source: I'm not sure what to expect with this movie, but I'm going to keep an open mind!
records.translation: 我不知道該對這部電影抱持什麼期待，不過會保持開放的心態！

records.source: That was simple, but good... It's like the comfort food of cinema.
records.translation: 很簡單，卻很美好……就像電影界的療癒美食。

records.source: From the movie poster, this one looks pretty cheesy.
records.translation: 從海報來看，這部電影似乎相當俗氣。

records.source: That was kind of lowbrow, wasn't it?
records.translation: 這部片有點低俗，對吧？

records.source: I'm so happy to have an excuse to come to Pelican Town!
records.translation: 能有個理由來鵜鶘鎮，我太開心了！

records.source: That was a lot of fun, thanks for inviting me! I'd better head home soon...
records.translation: 真的很有趣，謝謝你邀請我！我最好趕快回家了……

records.source: I foresee this to be an exquisite night!
records.translation: 我預見今晚將無比美妙！

records.source: I feel as if my spirit is charged... as if the energy of the film was transferred to me. Incredible!
records.translation: 我感覺精神彷彿充滿力量……好像電影的能量轉移到了自己身上。不可思議！

records.source: I've avoided all information about this film... I like to go in completely 'blind'!
records.translation: 我避開了所有關於這部片的資訊……我喜歡在完全「一無所知」的情況下觀看！

records.source: Very interesting... I'll be pondering that one for a while.
records.translation: 非常有意思……我會思考這部電影好一陣子。

records.source: It would be a lie to say I'm looking forward to this one...$s
records.translation: 如果說我期待這部電影，那就是在撒謊……$s

records.source: That was very mundane, don't you think?
records.translation: 實在非常平庸，不覺得嗎？

records.source: Hehe... I'd never turn down a free movie!
records.translation: 嘿嘿……免費電影我從來不會拒絕！

records.source: Ah, that reminds me of a story me ol' Pops used to tell...
records.translation: 啊，這讓我想起老爸以前常說的一個故事……

records.source: I'm excited to see this one... I want to learn everything about the world!
records.translation: 我很期待這部電影……我想了解世界上的一切！

records.source: Leo is glued to the screen!
records.translation: 雷歐目不轉睛地盯著銀幕！

records.source: Did you see that? They showed the fern islands... that's where I'm from!$h
records.translation: 看到了嗎？他們拍到了蕨島群島……那是我的家鄉！$h

records.source: I'm really happy to be here. This is all so interesting!
records.translation: 能來到這裡，我真的很開心。所有事情都如此有趣！

records.source: Leo seems very interested in the movie.
records.translation: 雷歐似乎對這部電影非常感興趣。

records.source: Wow... it was like magic!
records.translation: 哇……就像魔法一樣！
